key_insight: Activations inspired by the Biot–Savart kernel improve incompressible-flow PINNs without changing their velocity–pressure formulation.
engineering_relevance: Flow-informed activations offer a targeted way to improve neural fluid solvers, including their resolution of localized shear structures.
method: Extract a smooth rational activation profile from a regularized Biot–Savart kernel.
Test fixed and learnable kernel-scale variants.
Retain conventional physics-informed training to isolate the activation’s influence.
evidence_signal: Across five flow benchmarks and 21 benchmark–architecture comparisons, both variants consistently reduced combined velocity error versus tanh PINNs, with mean relative reductions of 31.7% and 33.2%.
watch_item: The abstract does not report computational overhead or establish generalization beyond the tested benchmarks and architectures.
paper_title: Stochastic Representation-Inspired Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Incompressible Fluid Flows
